summary: Satellos Bioscience filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated November 5, 2026, announcing an investor call and audio webcast for 8:00 a.m. ET on November 6, 2026, to update the clinical and regulatory strategy for BASECAMP, its Phase 2 pediatric study of forazapadin in boys aged 7-9 with Duchenne muscular dystrophy. Remarks will come from CEO Frank Gleeson and CMO Wildon Farwell. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or structural mechanics are disclosed; this is a routine clinical-update and investor-communications notice, not a special situation. Watch for study-design or regulatory-pathway changes.
